Messages.Author: Ector
Messages.Body:
1) Is it legal to play several copies of the same Trophy on a vampire?
Can I play two Trophies: Domain to get +2 intercept?

2) Is the following sequence legal:

Turn 1: Make two transfers on Boy Toy, another two on Xaviar.
Turn 2: Boy Toy plays Sibyl's Tongue for Trophy:Retainers, make 4 more
transfers on Xaviar.
Turn 3: Make 4 last transfers on Xaviar and move him to my ready
region.
Turn 4: Place Trophy:Retainers on Xaviar as a master-phase action.
Turn 5: During my upkeep, fetch Raven Spy and put it on Xaviar.
Turn 6: Fetch Dog Pack.
Turn 7: Fetch Jackie Therman.
Turn 8: Fetch Murder of Crows
... and fetch a retainer each turn?

Messages.Author: XZealot
Messages.Body:
"Ector" <Ec...@mail.ru> wrote in message
news:1109629186.4...@o13g2000cwo.googlegroups.com...

> 1) Is it legal to play several copies of the same Trophy on a vampire?
> Can I play two Trophies: Domain to get +2 intercept?
>
> 2) Is the following sequence legal:
>
> Turn 1: Make two transfers on Boy Toy, another two on Xaviar.

Legal

> Turn 2: Boy Toy plays Sibyl's Tongue for Trophy:Retainers, make 4 more
> transfers on Xaviar.

Legal

> Turn 3: Make 4 last transfers on Xaviar and move him to my ready
> region.

Legal

> Turn 4: Place Trophy:Retainers on Xaviar as a master-phase action.

Illegal, Trophies are put into play, not put on vampires. They are only put
on vampires once that vampire has burned a Red List Minion. Xaviar has
failed that qualification and therfore no Trophies of any sort may be placed
on him.

--

Messages.Author: Jeroen Rombouts
Messages.Body:
"Ector" <Ec...@mail.ru> schreef in bericht
news:1109629186.4...@o13g2000cwo.googlegroups.com...

> 1) Is it legal to play several copies of the same Trophy on a vampire?
> Can I play two Trophies: Domain to get +2 intercept?

I quess so.

>
> 2) Is the following sequence legal:
>
> Turn 1: Make two transfers on Boy Toy, another two on Xaviar.
> Turn 2: Boy Toy plays Sibyl's Tongue for Trophy:Retainers, make 4 more
> transfers on Xaviar.
> Turn 3: Make 4 last transfers on Xaviar and move him to my ready
> region.
> Turn 4: Place Trophy:Retainers on Xaviar as a master-phase action.

you mean:

Turn 4: put trophy: Retainers in play. Xaviar makes puts someone on the red
list, if no red minion is on the table
Turn 5: during your master phase: activate the Red listedness of a minion.
Xaviar uses the rush action and burns the Red listed minion. you may search
for another Trophy (hand, deck,...) and put it on Xaviar. you may now put
the Trophy: Retainers on Xaviar. (and any others other Meths have played and
want to give you)

the rules (http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/index.php?line=Preview_KMW_Trophy)
clearly state that "it [a trophy] has no effect until it is moved to a
vampire"

> Turn 5: During my upkeep, fetch Raven Spy and put it on Xaviar.

upkeep??? Wrong game. You mean untap Phase, right?

> Turn 6: Fetch Dog Pack.
> Turn 7: Fetch Jackie Therman.
> Turn 8: Fetch Murder of Crows
> ... and fetch a retainer each turn?

yup. but the set-up is a bit more difficult than you thought. and the turn
numbers are 2 higher.
